observations.format: Chinese source, one newline, Korean translation; trailing OSC arguments true,true

rule.uncertainty: Actual source-first bilingual framing agrees with the saved message/translation template. A missing target section supplies no translated text. Source is application ASR, not reference truth. No universal revision, resend, pagination or finality semantics are established; ambiguous new payloads require run-bound inspection.

binding_policy: Bind only the observed D3 preflight coverage. Both D1 checks emitted no payload and D1 is not admitted. Preflight clocks, sequence IDs and trace lines identify evidence only; never transfer them as main-run relationships or alignment links.
